data.gender_notes: Fukairaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fakara' meaning 'to be poor', Fukairaa signifies a person who is rich in blessings from Allah. The name Fukairaa carries the meaning “Rich in blessings” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fukairaa usually hope their child will grow to embody rich in blessings and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It symbolizes the blessed state of being spiritually rich while materially poor and instills a sense of gratitude and reliance on Allah's sustenance.
